1.explanation:
• FluidTimePicker.js – this is where the component reads invalid/invalidText but doesn’t handle warn/warnText or apply the correct ‘bx--text-input--warning’ className or the new warning icon.  
• FluidTimePicker.stories.js – we need to add a live demo of the warning variant so designers and engineers can see and test it in Storybook.  
• FluidTimePicker-test.js – the unit tests currently only cover the invalid case and will need to be expanded to ensure warn and warnText render correctly.  
• _fluid-time-picker.scss (carbon-components & carbon-components-react) – these files drive the actual CSS shipped for the fluid time picker.  They must be updated to:  
  – add the yellow border, icon color and text color rules for the new warning state,  
  – correct the existing spacing around the error icon to exactly 1 rem (16 px) from the edge of the time input,  
  – ensure that the invalid styles match our other form components (e.g. bottom padding for the message, red text color, outline style).
1.bug_scenario: When a consumer of the FluidTimePicker passes invalid={true} (and invalidText) today the red border, icon and error message either don’t render in the same way as our other fluid form components or the spacing is off.  Even worse, there is no support for a “warning” state at all, so passing warn={true} (and warnText) silently does nothing.  In the spec we need the same red outline, error icon and red help text with correct 1 rem spacing around the icon, plus a new yellow outline, yellow warning icon and neutral-text help message for the warning state.

2.explanation:
• FluidTimePicker.js and index.js: need to wire up the warn and warnText props in addition to invalid/invalidText, applying the same class names that FluidTextInput uses (e.g. 'bx--text-input--invalid', 'bx--text-input--warning') and rendering the warning message node.
• FluidTimePicker.stories.js: add a story for the warning state so designers and consumers can preview warn styling.
• __tests__/FluidTimePicker-test.js: add unit test coverage for warn/warnText and verify the proper warning class and message appear.
• _fluid-time-picker.scss (carbon-components): add CSS rules for the warning state on the input container—yellow outline, icon fill, and margin (1rem) between the icon and input—as well as tighten up the error-icon spacing per spec.
• _fluid-time-picker.scss (carbon-components-react): mirror those SCSS changes in the React bundle so the updated styles are shipped to consumers.
• e2e/components/FluidTimePicker/FluidTextInput-test.e2e.js: update or add tests that assert the warning outline, icon color, and text message render correctly in browser automation.
2.bug_scenario: When a FluidTimePicker is rendered with the invalid or warn prop, its text‐input box does not pick up the correct red or yellow outline, icon positioning and spacing, or the error/warning text styling beneath. The design spec calls for a red border and red message for errors, and a yellow warning icon and yellow message for warnings, with 1rem spacing between the input and icon. Currently only the invalid state is lightly supported and no warn state exists.
